verdict.rationale: Bevy's ECS model has systems run Queries over every matching entity, such as `Query<&Position>`. That gives code-level bulk processing across many items, which an agent can write through the code-first cargo workflow. The first-party Bevy Remote Protocol is mentioned only in passing as the basis for nascent community tooling, with no evidence it supports bulk queries or mutations. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk mutation APIs, evidence that BRP or any agent-facing interface supports multi-entity operations, an official MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration.
